lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\Reporting\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.
appinfo/info.xml names 1 class that appinfo/ and lib/ do not have. The server fails when it comes to load one.
